subject: INLA crashing with interaction between structured space and structured time

messages.author: bc1d54f6a56ba11d
messages.subject: INLA crashing with interaction between structured space and structured time
parts:
I have a dataset of hourly traffic counts at 96 signalised intersections. The data is recorded over six months. I am obtaining reasonable predictions for the final day after running the model for eight weeks prior. However this is specifying an iid interaction between space and time. I would like to try the interaction between structured space and structured time, but the model is crashing. Is this the correct way to specify the model? 
ID.area.int <- data.subset$ID #Intersections 1 to 96 
ID.year.int <- data.subset$Time #Time 1 to 1344 per ID 
formula.intIV = Y ~ f(ID, model = "bym", graph = H) + f(Time,model="seasonal",season.length=48) + f(Time1, model = "iid") + f(ID.area.int, model="besag", graph = H, group = ID.year.int, control.group = list(model = "rw2")) 
mod.intIV <- inla(formula.intIV,family="poisson",data = data.subset, control.predictor=list(link = 1, compute = TRUE), verbose = T)
I have tried changing the number of threads and 'control.inla = list(strategy = "gaussian", int.strategy = "eb"))'. It is running for several hours, then crashes with a Windows dialog 'inla.exe has crashed'. Am I specifying the interaction correctly?

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA crashing with interaction between structured space and structured time
parts:
In the control group you use the rw2, but I do not know if this has constraints or not.
You also use the bym for the spatial effect added to the space-time effect.
Your model may not be identifiable.
Try putting constraints on the rw2, or try to swap rw2 out for an ar1.
Try removing the bym part.

Best,
Haakon
